title: Refund and cancellation policy
content:
## Cancellation policy

You can cancel your CloudDash subscription at any time.

### How to cancel
1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Cancel Subscription**.
2. Select a cancellation reason (optional but helps us improve).
3. Click **Confirm Cancellation**.

### What happens after cancellation
- Your account remains active until the end of the current billing period.
- No further charges are made after cancellation.
- Your data is retained for 30 days after the billing period ends, then permanently deleted.
- You can reactivate within 30 days to restore all data.

## Refund policy

### 30-day money-back guarantee
- New customers are eligible for a full refund within **30 days of their first paid charge**.
- To request: email billing@clouddash.io with your account ID and reason.
- Refunds are processed within **5–7 business days** to the original payment method.

### After 30 days
- Refunds after 30 days are granted **only in exceptional circumstances** (e.g., billing errors, duplicate charges, extended service outages exceeding SLA).
- Partial refunds may be issued at CloudDash's discretion.
- Requests must be submitted within **90 days** of the charge.

### Non-refundable items
- Annual plan discounts already applied
- Overage charges that have already been incurred
- Usage-based add-ons

## Duplicate charge refunds
If you have been charged twice for the same period, this is always refunded in full. Contact billing@clouddash.io with both invoice IDs.
